brief: REPAIR.LOG happy-client figure for Wren Tallis (customers.ts: Studio master ledger, dominant ward, tiers 1-2), matching the three existing REPAIR.LOG figures' exact construction (ui-demos/kpos-shell/art/report-client-{sable,juno,aldous}.png / dive-report.html): a full-body, waist-up-or-taller figure celebrating with their fixed device, 1990s anime OVA ink style, flat cel shading, no text or speech bubbles or panel borders or lettering of any kind anywhere in the frame (this constraint has caused retakes before - hold to it strictly). Wren is a music producer hugging or leaning happily over their studio master ledger rig (a compact mixing/mastering console), headphones around the neck, visible relief and delight at hearing every track again. Background a plain soft dark gradient only, no scene detail competing with the figure. NOTE: no appearance canon exists yet for this customer; this order waits on the loremaster's ruling on customer figure likenesses before art-lead spends any credits on it.
